sn1.50:1.1: Avihaṃ upapannāse || vimuttā satta bhikkhavo || rāgadosaparikkhīṇā || tiṇṇā loke visattikan ti || ||
sn1.50:2.1: Ke ca te ataruṃ paṅkaṃ || maccudheyyaṃ suduttaraṃ || te hitvā mānusaṃ dehaṃ || dibbayogam upaccagun ti || ||
sn1.50:3.1: Upako Phalagaṇḍo ca || Pukkusāti ca te tayo || Bhaddiyo Khaṇḍadevo ca || Bāhuraggi ca Piṅgiyo || te hitvā mānusaṃ dehaṃ || dibbayogam upaccagun ti || ||
sn1.50:4.1: Kusalaṃ bhāsasi tesaṃ || mārapāsappahāyinaṃ || kassa te dhammam aññāya || acchiduṃ bhavabhandhanan ti || ||
sn1.50:5.1: Na aññatra Bhagavatā || naññatra tava sāsanā || yassa te dhammam aññāya || acchiduṃ bhavabandhanaṃ || ||
sn1.50:6.1: yattha nāmañca rupañca || asesam uparujjhati || taṃ te dhammam idha ñāya || acchiduṃ bhavabandhanan ti || ||
sn1.50:7.1: Gambhīraṃ bhāsasi vācaṃ || dubbijānam sudubbudhaṃ || kassa tvaṃ dhammam aññaya || vācam bhāsasi īdisanti || ||
sn1.50:8.1: Kumbhakāro pure āsiṃ || Vehaḷiṅge ghaṭīkaro || mātāpettibharo āsiṃ || Kassapassa upāsako ||
sn1.50:9.1: virato methunā dhammā || brahmacārī nirāmiso || ahuvā te sagāmeyyo || ahuvā te pure sakhā ||
sn1.50:10.1: so-ham ete pajānāmi || vimutte satta bhikkhave || rāgadosaparikkhīṇe || tiṇṇe loke visattikan ti || ||
sn1.50:11.1: Evam etaṃ tadā āsi || yathā bhāsasi Bhaggava || kumbhakāro pure āsi || Vehaḷiṅge ghaṭikāro || mātāpettibharo āsi || Kassapassa upāsako ||
sn1.50:12.1: virato methunā dhammā || brahmacārī nirāmiso || ahuvā me sagāmeyyo || ahuvā me pure sakhā ti || ||
sn1.50:13.1: evam etaṃ purāṇānaṃ || sahāyānam ahu saṅgamo || ubhinnaṃ bhāvitattānaṃ || sarīrantimadhārinan ti || || Āditta-vaggo pañcamo || ||
sn1.50:14.0: Tass-uddānaṃ || Ādittaṃ Kiṃdadam Annaṃ || Ekamūla Anomiyaṃ || Accharā Vanaropetaṃ || Maccherena Ahaṭīkaro ti || || ___________________________________________
